candidates.name: Official Codex Python SDK
candidates.disposition: Selected native GPT coding worker; new revision awaits real-provider acceptance.
candidates.reason: Uses the same native app-server, skills, MCP tools, thread state, model/effort settings and lifecycle API rather than replacing the client harness.

candidates.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
candidates.disposition: Conditional application orchestration; not installed in this trial.
candidates.reason: Useful when application handoffs, guardrails, sessions or MCP orchestration are required. Native coding state integration needs its own acceptance.

candidates.name: LangGraph
candidates.disposition: Conditional durable application graph; not installed in this trial.
candidates.reason: Checkpointed durable graphs fit workflows that require them. The native coding lifecycle does not by itself establish that requirement.

candidates.name: OpenHands SDK
candidates.disposition: Conditional isolated-worker candidate; not installed in this trial.
candidates.reason: A separate worker runtime requires frozen isolation, task, lifecycle and quality comparisons before adoption. Its SDK and CLI versions are separate.

candidates.name: Claude Agent SDK through OmniRoute
candidates.reason: Prior bridge failures do not qualify a GPT model inside the Claude harness. Native Claude can delegate a GPT worker through the official Codex SDK.
